title: honor --include-volumes in podman-remote commit
body:
Running `podman --remote commit --include-volumes` did not save the container's volumes in the new image. The option was never sent to the server so it was silently ignored. This passes the option through the remote client and the API, and turns on the existing test for remote mode.
The test fails without this fix and passes with it.

```release-note
Fixed `podman --remote commit --include-volumes` not adding the container volumes to the image.
```

comments.body:
Thanks.....There is no existing issue, I found this while checking which options podman-remote drops.
I have added the schema: "includeVolumes" tag to the bindings field as suggested.
